WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX <> ''
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT sex, record_count
  FROM sex_counts
  WHERE record_count > (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM sex_counts)
)
SELECT sex,
       record_count,
       CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM sex_counts) AS above_group_average
FROM above_average
